title: Sales By Customer appears in Reports navigation and opens with correct titles
permissions_required: Sales By Customer report View permission (dedicated per S1-R2 — exact permission name in the roles screen is VIU-confirm).
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. Your role has the Sales By Customer report View permission.
steps: 1. Open the Reports area from the main navigation.
2. Look through the Reports left-side navigation for the report entry.
4. Read the page title at the top of the report and the browser tab's title.
expected: 1. "Sales By Customer" is listed in the Reports left-side navigation.
2. Clicking it opens the Sales By Customer report in the main content area.
3. The page title reads "Sales By Customer."
4. The browser tab title reads "Sales By Customer - Report | ShopView".
design_ref: none - SPEC-ONLY (Report Suite has no designs yet)
notes: The spec does not name a navigation group for this report (unlike SBR's Performance group) — VIU-confirm where in the Reports navigation the entry sits.
